name: fpocket
summary: Geometry-based detection and description of protein binding pockets from structures.

steps: The reviewed fpocket conda-forge 4.2.3 release has no native Windows build. Use a separately prepared Linux/WSL environment and rerun plan there; do not execute the Linux command in native Windows.
Check the maintainer's source or container instructions if WSL is unsuitable, and review the container image tag and mount paths before running it.
manual_fallback.verify_note: Within the chosen Linux environment, run the fpocket command and compare a small public structure with the maintainer examples.

notes: The conda package contains the command-line program; this route does not install a GUI or run pocket detection on user structures. Pocket rank and druggability scores require scientific review.
